title: Compliance circuit rehearsal: SOC2 & ISO evidence gates, rollback drills, and release handoff
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Objective: Run a cross-functional 'circuit rehearsal' for SOC2/ISO compliance deliverables that validates evidence pipelines, SSO/SAML cutover steps, and audit-log retention before the April compliance release. Deliver a signed checklist, rollback playbook, and a prioritized remediation backlog.

Scope: End-to-end verification of evidence generation (logging, retention, ownership), SSO/SAML integration test scenarios, audit-log ingestion to retention store, evidence export for auditors, and release-side rollback procedures. Excludes full rework of existing identity provider (IdP) integrations.

Acceptance criteria:
- Signed checklist covering all SOC2/ISO controls in scope with owner assignments.
- Automated smoke tests for SSO sign-in flows and audit-log creation across 3 environments (staging, preprod, private).
- Playbook for release rollback validated in a simulated outage with <30 min recovery for user-auth flows.
- Evidence export run and schema validated by audit liaison.

Success metrics:
- 0 critical gaps at rehearsal, <=3 medium findings tracked to release.
- Rehearsal runbook executed within planned 4-hour window by cross-functional team.
- Regression rate for auth flows <1% during rollout window.

Risks & mitigations:
- Risk: Audit evidence pipeline missing historical events. Mitigation: Run backfill job and validate checksums.
- Risk: IdP metadata drift during cutover. Mitigation: Preflight metadata validation and lockfile.

Deliverables:
- Checklist (Confluence link), rollback playbook, rehearsal runbook with role play matrix, remediation ticket list.
